required_points: Under Section 2(7), 'dishonestly' means doing anything with the intention of causing wrongful gain to one person or wrongful loss to another person.
optional_points: The answer may cross-reference wrongful gain (Section 2(36)) and wrongful loss (Section 2(37)).
forbidden_points: Dishonestly means acting with malice or violence.
Dishonestly requires an intention to cause physical harm.
